d: Bengluru ki ek aisi khauphnak vardat jisne pure desh ko jhakjhor kar rakh diya. mahaj 16 dinon ke bhitar ek kaib draivar indushekhar ne apni patni, sas, donon salon aur bachchon samet ek hi parivar ki tin pirhiyon ke 7 logon ko berahmi se maut ke ghat utar diya. 'PRESS' ka stikar lagi kar men lashon ko bharkar vah do rajyon ke ghane janglon men thikane lagata raha. lekin ek 11 sal ke masum bachche ke bayan ne is 'Cab Wala Serial Killer' ke pure plan par pani pher diya. dekhie khabarganv ke sho 'Wanted' ke is episod men is mas mardar mistri ki puri insaid stori.
